instructions.objective: Launch Bridge2Babble on this real iPhone. Confirm English is selected as the source language and Spanish is selected as the destination language. Do not use Apple Intelligence. If the app says the language pair needs a download, tap its Download or Prepare Offline control and allow the system translation download if it is offered. Wait for completion, then verify whether the status becomes 'Ready offline' using Apple Translation. If downloading is unavailable or fails, record the exact visible error or readiness status. Do not enter any patient data.

approach_reason: The agent started the required language downloads but dismissed the Translate download sheet while both languages still showed active download indicators. It then checked the app again while the visible pair status was still "English → Spanish: Needs download," rather than waiting for the download to finish and recording that status as instructed.

Run the download flow again, leave the system download process time to complete, and repeatedly check the language-pair status. If it remains unavailable, save the exact visible status instead of asserting "Ready offline."
